items.title: Windiarto
items.summary: A catalog website for a machinery store. Buyers browse, compare, and order straight through WhatsApp without creating an account, while the owner manages everything from an admin dashboard: products, banners, agenda reminders, and every piece of text on the site.

items.title: Baru Raya Toys
items.summary: An online toy store with a full shopping flow: product catalog, cart, checkout with Midtrans payment, shipping costs, Google login, WhatsApp order updates, a bilingual interface, and an admin panel with staff roles.

items.title: Suki Floris
items.summary: A shopping app for gardening equipment that makes buying tools practical and efficient. Designed in Figma, built as a Kotlin Android app, and powered by its own Laravel API.

items.title: Horror Game 3D
items.summary: My first 3D game, built in Unreal Engine with Blueprint. It focuses on atmosphere, exploration, and basic gameplay mechanics.

items.title: 2D Game
items.summary: A 2D game where the player collects every coin in the level to finish. Built with Unity and C#, featuring player movement and collision detection.

items.title: Defion
items.summary: A practice project inspired by Dribbble: a modern digital-asset platform concept with a clean, responsive interface, built to learn React.

items.title: GrabTrash
items.summary: An educational app that encourages people to dispose of waste properly through a points system that can be exchanged for discount coupons.

items.title: LokerKu
items.summary: A job-portal website designed to make searching and applying for vacancies quick and practical.

items.title: Danishood
items.summary: A news website that delivers the latest, most reliable information to keep readers up to date.

items.title: Personal Website 2.0
items.summary: The second version of my portfolio, with a more modern look and features that present my profile and career journey.

items.title: Personal Website 1.0
items.summary: My very first personal website: a profile, a career path, and a direct way to reach me by email.
